prompt: I need you to create a comprehensive 5-year DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) financial model for TechCorp Inc. in an Excel file named 'techcorp_dcf_model.xlsx'. The model must include: (1) A 'Assumptions' sheet with key inputs like revenue growth rates (15%, 12%, 10%, 8%, 6% for years 1-5), EBITDA margins (25%, 27%, 28%, 29%, 30%), tax rate (21%), discount rate (10%), and terminal growth rate (2.5%). (2) A 'P&L Projection' sheet with 5-year projections starting from 2024 base revenue of $100M, including Revenue, EBITDA, Depreciation ($5M annually), EBIT, Taxes, and Net Income rows. (3) A 'Cash Flow' sheet showing Operating Cash Flow, CapEx ($8M annually), Free Cash Flow, PV of FCF, and Terminal Value calculations. (4) A 'Valuation Summary' sheet displaying Enterprise Value, Net Cash ($10M), and Equity Value. Use proper financial modeling conventions: blue text for inputs, black for formulas, professional formatting with currency in millions, and ensure all formulas reference the assumptions sheet. The file must have zero formula errors when recalculated.
